## Summary

- Enable `agent-daily-summary.yml` scheduled runs by default while keeping explicit disable overrides.
- Add a discussion footer command that disables future scheduled daily summaries for the current repository.
- Update docs and focused tests for the new default.

## Verification

- `npm --prefix .agent run build`
- `node --test dist/__tests__/schedule-policy.test.js dist/__tests__/scheduled-activity.test.js dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js` from `.agent`
- `git diff --check`

Closes #286

Part of #314

| coding_workflow / generic | Make surgical changes | pass | 8/8 | Diff is scoped to schedule-policy defaults, the daily-summary workflow footer, focused tests, and matching docs. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Reuse existing code | pass | 8/8 | Uses existing `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY`, `parseSchedulePolicy`, `getScheduleModeForWorkflow`, and scheduled activity gate paths instead of adding a parallel enable/disable mechanism. |
| coding_style / generic | Prefer simple implementations | pass | 7/7 | Removes the special daily-summary default override in `.agent/src/schedule-policy.ts` and the shell resolver, letting the existing default `skip_no_updates` mode apply. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Keep docs in sync | pass | 7/7 | Updates `README.md`, `.agent/docs/architecture/memory.md`, `.agent/docs/architecture/supported-workflows.md`, and `.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md` to describe the new default and disable override. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Minimal defaults, native escape hatches | pass | 8/8 | Default becomes activity-aware scheduled execution; the escape hatch remains the native repository variable `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` with a workflow override. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Prefer explicit structured inputs | pass | 7/7 | Disable guidance uses the existing typed JSON contract: `{"workflow_overrides":{"agent-daily-summary.yml":"disabled"}}`. |
| coding_workflow / generic | Make user-facing automation idempotent | partial | 5/7 | The footer command uses `gh variable set`, which is rerunnable, but it replaces the full `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` body and does not warn users with existing schedule policy overrides that copy-pasting may overwrite them. |
| communication / generic | Write audience-first documentation | pass | 6/7 | README and workflow docs lead with the operational behavior: daily summaries run by default, skip when there is no activity, and can be disabled via policy. |

## Notes

- The implementation matches issue #286’s requested behavior: scheduled daily summaries are enabled by default, use activity-aware skipping, and posted discussions include a current-repository disable command.
- The strongest rubric alignment is reuse of the existing schedule policy abstraction and synchronized documentation/test coverage.
- Smallest useful follow-up: make the disable footer mention that repositories with an existing `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` should merge the `agent-daily-summary.yml` override into their current JSON rather than blindly replacing the variable.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** The discussion footer’s `gh variable set AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY --body '{"workflow_overrides":{"agent-daily-summary.yml":"disabled"}}'` is idempotent for repeated disable attempts, but it can overwrite unrelated existing schedule policy settings. This is a rubric-specific concern under “Make user-facing automation idempotent,” not a blocker because the command matches the issue’s requested example and uses the current repository slug.

## Final Rubric Verdict

PASS

## AI Review Synthesis

<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis -->
<!-- sepo-agent-review-synthesis-head: eebdf06f7cdf48381080c815746c8d55f9049d81 -->

> Dual-agent review by **Claude** and **Codex**.
> Requested by @lolipopshock.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #326 implements issue #286 as part of the stacked small-fixes orchestration in #314. It enables scheduled daily summaries by default while preserving the existing `skip_no_updates` behavior so empty activity windows still skip posting. It also adds a repository-specific `gh variable set AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` command to daily summary discussion footers so users can disable future scheduled summaries. The diff updates the TypeScript and shell schedule-policy paths, focused tests, and matching user-facing docs.

## Review
Overall, the implementation is narrow, well-tested, and matches the requested behavior. Codex and Claude found no blockers; the rubrics review passed with one non-blocking warning about the disable command replacing the whole schedule policy value.

| Issue | Severity | Description |
| -- | -- | -- |
| Disable command can overwrite existing schedule policy | WARNING | The footer command disables daily summaries by setting the full `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` body, which can replace unrelated existing schedule-policy overrides if copied as-is. |
| Empty base override constant is vestigial | INFO | `BASE_SCHEDULE_WORKFLOW_OVERRIDES` is now an empty object after removing the daily-summary default override; this is harmless cleanup, not required follow-up. |

## Progress
- The PR is grounded in issue #286 and parent orchestration issue #314.
- Existing reviewers verified the runtime behavior, docs, and tests; Codex reported `npm --prefix .agent run build`, focused `node --test` suites, and `git diff --check` passing.
- Current PR inline comments and review threads are empty, so there was nothing to resolve or minimize.
- No new inline comment was posted because the only warning is already clearly covered in the existing rubrics review comment.

## Issue Details
<details>
<summary>Disable command can overwrite existing schedule policy</summary>

**Cause:** The new discussion footer suggests `gh variable set AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY --body '{"workflow_overrides":{"agent-daily-summary.yml":"disabled"}}'`, which replaces the entire variable value rather than merging with any existing JSON.

**Candidate solutions:** Leave as-is because it matches the issue’s requested example, or add a short note telling users with an existing `AGENT_SCHEDULE_POLICY` to merge the `agent-daily-summary.yml` override into their current JSON.

**Comments:** This is a product/docs judgment rather than a correctness blocker; the command is rerunnable and repository-specific.

</details>

<details>
<summary>Empty base override constant is vestigial</summary>

**Cause:** Removing the daily-summary disabled default leaves `BASE_SCHEDULE_WORKFLOW_OVERRIDES` empty while `DEFAULT_SCHEDULE_WORKFLOW_OVERRIDES` still spreads it.

**Candidate solutions:** Keep it for structural consistency, or inline/remove it in a later cleanup.

**Comments:** Claude explicitly marked this harmless and not worth a follow-up unless the split becomes confusing.

</details>

## Recommended Next Step
HUMAN_DECISION: the remaining concern is optional user-facing guidance about whether the disable command should warn about existing schedule-policy values, not required branch work.

## Final Verdict
MINOR_ISSUES

## Action Items
- [ ] No required branch-change work.
